amoxicillin_oral.indication: First-line antibiotic for PSBI when referral not feasible
amoxicillin_oral.instruction: Give by mouth using oral syringe. Give during breastfeeding if possible.

gentamicin_im.indication: Part of WHO PSBI simplified antibiotic regimen
gentamicin_im.instruction: Inject into anterolateral thigh. ONLY by trained health worker.

procaine_penicillin_im.instruction: Inject into anterolateral thigh. ONLY by trained health worker.

chlorhexidine_topical.indication: Umbilical cord care in high-mortality settings
chlorhexidine_topical.application: Apply thin layer to umbilical stump and surrounding skin
chlorhexidine_topical.frequency: Once daily until cord falls off
chlorhexidine_topical.instruction: Wash hands before application. Apply to stump and 2cm surrounding skin.
